# @tansy/storage-imgbb

imgbb for tansy file storage: free image hosting for a public site's pictures.

```bash
npm install @tansy/storage-imgbb
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the storage guide](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/guides/storage.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
